cues.en: The universe.
cues.zh: 宇宙。

cues.en: What a concept.
cues.zh: 真是个奇妙的概念。

cues.en: You know, the universe is a little bit like the human hand. For example, you have
cues.zh: 你知道，宇宙有点像人类的手掌。比如，

cues.en: Grauman's Center right here and then you have undiscovered worlds and
cues.zh: 这里是 Grauman's Center，接着是未被发现的世界，还有

cues.en: Sector 8. And up here, it's the Tillman's crest. So you can you can kind of picture that it's a little bit like a leaf or a or a... It's not a bowl. The universe is beautiful.
cues.zh: 8号扇区。上面这里则是 Tillman's crest。所以你可以想象它有点像一片叶子，或者……反正不是个碗。宇宙是美丽的。

cues.en: Something like a new woman that I was gonna date. You're dark and you're you're massive
cues.zh: 就像我正准备去约会的新对象。你幽暗、庞大，

cues.en: and you have a black hole and all of those elements I wanna explore just like you would explore on a new date. You wanna dive deep into them and and feel around and just see see what's gonna come out of that. The time it takes to get from one star to another star is you need to travel at the speed of light. And us humans can't even
cues.zh: 还有一个黑洞，所有这些元素我都想去探索，就像在新的约会中探索一样。你想深入其中，四处摸索，看看究竟会发生什么。从一颗恒星到另一颗恒星所需的时间，需要你以光速飞行。而我们人类甚至连

cues.en: fathom the concept of that kind of time because it's really really really really really really really
cues.zh: 好好琢磨一下那种时间的本质，因为它真的真的真的真的真的真的真的

cues.en: fun
cues.zh: 太有趣了

cues.en: to think about taking a speed of light ride.
cues.zh: 去想象一趟光速之旅。

cues.en: If you could put the universe into a tube, you'd end up with a very long tube,
cues.zh: 如果你能把宇宙塞进一根管子里，你最终会得到一根非常长的管子，

cues.en: probably extending,
cues.zh: 可能延伸出去，

cues.en: twice the size of the universe because when you collapse the universe, it expands
cues.zh: 有宇宙两倍那么大，因为当你压缩宇宙时，它会膨胀

cues.en: and it would be,
cues.zh: 而且它会变成，

cues.en: you wouldn't wanna put it into a tube.
cues.zh: 你根本不想把它塞进管子里。

cues.en: Picture a hot dog bun and and throw all the stars, the hundreds of stars that there are in the universe into a pack... Into a bag and put the universe into a bag and you all of a sudden, they become
cues.zh: 想象一个热狗面包，把所有的恒星，宇宙中那几百颗恒星全都扔进一个包……扔进一个袋子里，把宇宙装进袋子里，突然间，它们就变成了

cues.en: When I was a child, there was thought to be nine planets,
cues.zh: 我小时候，人们认为有九大行星，

cues.en: but there are now 90
cues.zh: 但现在有90

cues.en: planets.
cues.zh: 颗行星。

cues.en: You know, the ultimate fate of the universe is so dark and mysterious that it generates butterflies in my stomach and that goes to tickles in my spine and that creates goose pimples and then that penetrates my mind and then the whole big bang goes
cues.zh: 你知道，宇宙的最终命运如此黑暗而神秘，让我心里直打鼓，脊背发痒，起了一身鸡皮疙瘩，接着思绪越飘越远，最后整个大爆炸就……

cues.en: Stars can be fun. A lot of people say, Donna, you get so wrapped up in the physics of it. Don't you have any fun? I say, well, I go up and I look at the stars through my telescope and I see the little dipster or I see the big dipster. Every star has its... Has a sister star, a little bit like two eyeballs. If you can imagine...
cues.zh: 看星星也挺有意思。很多人会说：“唐娜，你总是沉浸在物理学里。就不能找点乐子吗？”我会说：“我会上楼，用望远镜看星星，看到小北斗，或者大北斗。每颗星星都有……都有一颗伴星，有点像两只眼睛。你可以想象一下……”

cues.en: If if
cues.zh: 如果……如果

cues.en: if you could see the other side of my eyeball, you'd see a 360 degree eyeball.
cues.zh: 如果你能看到我眼球的另一面，你会看到一个360度的全景眼球。

cues.en: Do you know that when you look at a planet
cues.zh: 你知道吗，当你仰望一颗行星

cues.en: and you see that light, that planet's not even there.
cues.zh: 看到那道光时，那颗行星其实根本不在那儿。

cues.en: That's just a light. That's just your neighbor shining a flashlight right into your yard
cues.zh: 那只是一道光，是你邻居正拿手电筒照进你家院子，

cues.en: looking for coons.
cues.zh: 在找浣熊呢。

cues.en: And he says,
cues.zh: 然后他说：

cues.en: what are you doing in my backyard
cues.zh: “你拿个手电筒

cues.en: with that flashlight?
cues.zh: 跑我家后院干嘛呢？”

cues.en: And I told him, I'm shining I'm shining in your window so I can teach your son about the universe.
cues.zh: 我跟他说：“我照的是你的窗户，好给你儿子讲讲这宇宙的奥秘。”

cues.en: He said, get out of my yard and why are you communicating to my son? Why are you in all black behind my bushes shining a light into my house? And I said, I'm teaching your son about the universe. I'm shining a light
cues.zh: 他说，滚出我的院子，你为什么要跟我儿子说话？你为什么一身黑衣躲在我的灌木丛后面，拿灯照进我家？我说，我在教你儿子认识宇宙。我在用光

cues.en: shining a light right in there and exploring his room as he's looking out and exploring the universe. I turn the light off and I see your son go to bed and I turn the the light back on and I do swirls on his wall like a comet's tail.
cues.zh: 照进去，探索他的房间，而他在向外看，探索宇宙。我关掉灯，看到你儿子去睡觉了，我又打开灯，在他墙上画出漩涡，像彗星的尾巴。

cues.en: I do this every night with your son.
cues.zh: 我每天晚上都和你儿子这么做。
